events.title: Public Speaking Workshop
events.description:
Speaker Workshop

Public Speaking Workshop

Join TEDxCMU for our first annual Speaking Workshop.

Learn about what makes a TED Talk shine, how to apply speaking insights to your everyday life, and build your talk-writing skills with us.

You’ll be able to hear from some of our previous student speakers, too!

When: September 27, 2026 • 5:00 PM

Where: DH 1212, Carnegie Mellon University

RSVP

Visual review: TEDxCMU public speaking workshop. The event date is confirmed as September 27, 2026. Official sources conflict on the time and venue: the homepage says 2:00 PM at Simmons Auditorium; the Events page says 5:00 PM at DH 1212; the linked public RSVP form says 3:00 PM at DH 1212. Time and venue require organizer confirmation. This record has date precision and does not assert an all-day event.

reviews.note: Fresh advertised SALSA Google Calendar visibly lists 12 HLAA Monthly Meeting occurrences from Nov10,2026 to Oct12,2027, 17:00–17:30 New York. Anonymous ICS was updated Oct13,2026, not merely a historical remnant. Expanded official CMU HLAA page identifies Hispanic-Latino/x Alumni Association and staff partner matching calendar host context; it is CMU-related, not an unrelated hearing-loss organization. SALSA is a recipient marked Needs RSVP, and public participation in this particular meeting is unconfirmed. Separately, public Instagram profile grid exposes a Sept18,2026 Fence Painting poster saying Sept26 at midnight, guarding starts Thursday. Its advertised public interest form instead says guarding Wed Sept30 and painting overnight Friday Oct3, without year; Oct3,2026 is Saturday. Conflicting announcement date and midnight semantics prevent a reliable historical event timestamp.
reviews.reason: HLAA recurring dates and CMU identity are confirmed, but receipt of an unanswered calendar invitation does not establish SALSA hosting or public access. Fence-painting poster and linked form disagree; form lacks year and contains a weekday/date mismatch if interpreted as2026. Original Instagram post detail requires login and CDN image URL is temporary. Neither item is confirmed empty.
reviews.nextStep: For HLAA, organizer should confirm intended attendees and whether the monthly meeting is public; preserve only sanitized review-candidate metadata, not meeting credentials. For Fence Painting, organizer should confirm year, exact night and final guarding/painting date, and publish a stable anonymous announcement/image. Do not add expiring CDN URLs as refresh sources, submit forms, or join groups.
